scope: Read-only actual retained native geometry audit; no GPU, new pose, asset edit or solver.

method.hand: All three triangle vertices each carry >=.5 summed skin weight from that side hand/finger joints in exact source GLB.
method.bodyTarget: All three vertices each carry >=.5 summed pelvis/thigh weight; a selected lower-body subset, not every body triangle.
method.trousers: Lower of two source connected components after rest-position weld at1e-7m;1712 triangles/950 raw vertices, source rest maxY<1m.
method.predicate: Existing intersectTriangles at1e-10m after AABB pruning; each retained witness also checked at1e-9 and1e-11m. Boundary contacts count; numbers are triangle-pair counts, not penetration volume.
method.limits: CPU-skinned world snapshots during native GPU run. Discrete poses only; no global inside/depth, continuous proof, or sole-writer attribution.

visualBinding.limits: The older image uses a temporary full-body camera; the retained snapshot world positions/topology exactly match the newer capture. No PNG byte equality is claimed between different views.
